links.comparator_used: Original AI-generated radiology report (text 1), not simplified
links.outcome: Readability (FRE, LIX) and patient-rated clarity, tone, structure, engagement and ability to understand findings without help
links.effect: FRE 51.1 (original) vs 55.0 (simplified, text 2) vs 56.4 (further simplified, text 3), P<.001; LIX lower for simplified texts; clarity and tone P<.001 for texts 2 and 3; understanding findings without help mean 1.5 (SD 0.7) for text 3 vs 3.1 (SD 1.4) for text 1
links.quote: Both simplified texts showed significantly higher readability scores (text 1: FRE score=51.1; text 2: FRE score=55.0; and text 3: FRE score=56.4; P<.001) and lower LIX scores, indicating enhanced clarity.
